help.title: Help
help.scoringBody: Use the orange keypad to record each ball. Undo marks the last ball as undone without deleting the audit trail. Playing XI, overs, and scoring rules lock once the match is live.
help.offlineBody: If the network drops, deliveries stay in a local queue and sync when you are back online. Duplicate balls are blocked by an idempotency key.
help.liveBody: Share the public live page with viewers. The overlay URL is a transparent browser source for OBS or YouTube. Chat, quiz, and video stay on the public page, not on the overlay.
help.rolesBody: Admins manage assigned tournaments and matches. Scorers can score only matches they are assigned to. Viewers and public visitors are read-only.

tournament.sport: CrickScore is for cricket only. Tennis and leather ball formats are supported.
tournament.club: Optional. Link this tournament to a club so it appears with that club’s events.

tournament.visibility: Public tournaments can be found by others. Unlisted is share-by-link. Private stays invite-only.
tournament.noTeams: Add existing teams or create a new team, then they will appear here and in the points table.
tournament.overs: Legal overs per innings for new matches in this tournament. Default is 5.
tournament.wickets: Maximum wickets per innings for new matches. Default is 7. The last wicket ends the innings.
tournament.mvp: Tournament MVP sums match MVP points from completed matches in this tournament only.
tournament.points: Win = 2 points. Tie = 1. No result = 1. Loss = 0. Ranked by points, then NRR.

scoring.rules: Legal balls count toward the over. Wides and no-balls do not complete a legal ball. After the over or wicket limit, or when the chase target is reached, no more balls can be added.

fanQuiz.enable: Allows fans to participate in quizzes associated with this tournament.
fanQuiz.publish: Publishing makes the quiz available to eligible fans.

match.overTheFence: When on, a hit over the fence can be recorded as a wicket in tennis-ball rules.

match.extrasToBatsman: When on, some extras are also counted in the striker’s personal runs.

match.season: Attach this match to a tournament season, or leave it as a standalone fixture.
match.statusFilter: Filter by upcoming, live, completed, or cancelled. Live includes innings break.

settings.logoutAll: Signs you out on this device and every other logged-in device.

beta.testers: Invite people outside your team to try CrickScore before a public release — they get a one-time invite link, no shared passwords. Use this to give a scorer or viewer access to a specific match or tournament for testing, collect their feedback from Beta Feedback, and disable or revoke access once testing is done.

rules.custom: Custom rules change how runs are counted. Leave this off to use standard cricket scoring.
rules.priority: Lower numbers run first when more than one rule could apply.
rules.matchResult: When on, this rule changes the match score shown to everyone.
rules.tournamentPoints: When on, this rule can change points awarded in the table.
rules.nrr: When on, this rule is included in net run rate. Leave off if it is only a display bonus.
rules.displayOnly: When on, the rule is shown but does not change the official score.
rules.ballsPerOver: Default balls per over for new matches under this tournament.
rules.winningBonus: Extra points added to the standard 2 for winning a match. Applies to the points table for every completed match.
rules.tiePoints: Points each team gets when a match is tied and ends with shared points, instead of a Super Over. Defaults to 1.
rules.hattrick: Automatically awards bonus runs to a bowler for taking 3 wickets in 3 consecutive legal deliveries. The optional penalty reduces the batting team's total for the same hattrick.
rules.penalties: Lets scorers add or subtract a fixed number of penalty runs during a match, with a reason attached (e.g. slow over rate, misconduct).
rules.bonusRules: Configure extra bonus scoring for this tournament — awarded automatically as the match is scored.
rules.boundaryStreakBonus: Adds bonus runs automatically when 3 consecutive legal balls, all within the same over, are each hit for a four or six — regardless of which batsman is on strike.
rules.sixBonus: Adds extra bonus runs automatically whenever a six is hit.
rules.overWiseDefault: When on, every match created in this tournament starts with over-wise rules enabled. Add rules below to apply the same per-over targets and bonuses to every match automatically — or leave the list empty and set them per match instead.

scoring.extra: Choose how many extra runs to add, and any runs the batter also scored on that ball.

mvp.runsPer10: Points scored per 10 runs, once the minimum runs below is reached. Not rounded down, so 68 runs = 6.8 points.
mvp.minRuns: Minimum runs needed before batting points start counting.
mvp.fifty: Extra points awarded for scoring 50 or more runs in the innings.
mvp.hundred: Extra points awarded for scoring 100 or more runs in the innings.
mvp.strikeRate: Strike rate a batter must reach to earn the strike-rate bonus below.
mvp.srMinRuns: Minimum runs needed before the strike-rate bonus can apply.
mvp.srBonus: Extra points awarded when both the minimum runs and strike-rate threshold above are met.
mvp.threeWickets: Extra points awarded for taking 3 or more wickets in the innings.
mvp.fiveWickets: Extra points awarded for taking 5 or more wickets in the innings.
mvp.maidenOver: Extra points awarded for each maiden over bowled — an over with no runs conceded.
mvp.runOut: Points awarded per run out, credited to the fielder involved.
